title: CheckEvidence
description: What one test run OBSERVED: each check that ran, and whether it passed or failed. Produced by a per-stack evidence probe reading its runner's output, consumed by `rqunit evidence record`, which folds the run into the store's ledger and owns every judgment — including which observation is a check's first failure. A probe reports outcomes; deciding that an outcome is a FIRST requires history, and history is the framework's business.

generated_by.description: Probe name and version — names the source for anyone reading the ledger or an error that quotes it.

observations.description: One entry per check the run executed. A check the run skipped is omitted: 'not run' is a distinct answer from 'passed', and only the framework may act on the difference.

check_id.description: The stack-qualified check id the scanner reports for this test (contract: scanned-checks.schema.json). The two contracts share one identity space, which is what lets evidence attach to a check an RU verifies against.

outcome.description: What the runner reported for this check in THIS run. Carries no timestamp: a probe's output must be a byte-deterministic function of its input, and core stamps the recording time.
